name: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Come Of Age
seoTitle: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows, UMS: Come Of Age
description: Here's René Moffatt with his full band, playing his song Come Of Age at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver in the summer of 2026. This is his folk and Americana sound with drums and bass behind it.
